text_fr: Sur la proposition du PRESIDENT le Comité décide de se réunir de nouveau, ce même jour, à 8.30 du soir.
text_en: On the proposal of the PRESIDENT the Committee decided to meet again at 8.30 in the evening.

text_en: The PRESIDENT opened the debate upon Article 12 and the following Articles of the drafting Committee's text.

text_en: In consequence of a proposal made by the PRESIDENT the members of the Committee agreed that the Article was not necessary; consequently it was deleted.

text_en: This Article was adopted. In consequence of a question asked by M. RICCI-BUSATTI, it was decided that the Court should meet every year; it should meet even though there might be no cases to deal with.

text_fr: Les alinéas 1 et 5 sont adoptés.
text_en: Paragraphs 1 and 5 were adopted.

text_en: The Committee, on LORD PHILLIMORE's proposal, decided to make these two Paragraphs into a new Article 22.

text_en: Paragraphs 2, 3 and 4 were reserved.

text_en: LORD PHILLIMORE and M. DE LAPRADELLE thought that the article should be read in this way. On their proposal it was decided to add the words: "at the request of the contesting parties."

text_en: A deputy-judge is elected in the same way. The new judge replaces the retiring judge for the remainder of the latter's appointment; the same applies to a deputy-judge replacing a retired deputy judge.

text_en: On LORD PHILLIMORE's proposal, the Committee decided that the President's salary should only be fixed for three years; this decision rendered a modification in Paragraph 2 necessary.

text_fr: MM. ROOT et HAGERUP s'opposent à la fixation du traitement des suppléants à un tiers de celui des titulaires.
text_en: Mr. ROOT and M. HAGERUP were opposed to the idea of fixing the salary of the deputy-judges at one third of that of the judges.

text_en: Mr. ROOT and LORD PHILLIMORE preferred to leave the contents of Paragraph 3 to be decided by the League of Nations.

text_fr: La discussion s'engage sur la portée du terme „protectorat” et „protégés”.
text_en: A discussion took place as to the meaning of the terms “Protectorate” and “Protégés”.

text_fr: Selon M. DE LAPRADELLE, les ressortissants des protectorats sont assimilés aux ressortissants de la métropole.
text_en: According to M. DE LAPRADELLE, the inhabitants of protectorates are classified with subjects of the protecting State.

text_fr: M. ALTAMIRA s'oppose, au point de vue de la langue espagnole, à cette interprétation.
text_en: M. ALTAMIRA was opposed to this interpretation, in view of the meaning conveyed by the corresponding Spanish phrase.

text_en: Mr. ROOT pointed out the danger of the Committee's becoming involved in international legislation. The discussion of the Article was adjourned to the evening meeting.
